description: The bar chart illustrates the Accuracy (%) of different models or systems evaluated under two conditions. The horizontal axis displays the categories, which consist of a first label that is obscured by a gray rectangular box, followed by "Audio-Reasoner" and "Qwen-2.5-Omni". The vertical axis represents the value, labeled "Accuracy (%)", and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 60 with tick marks at regular intervals of 10. The chart features grouped bars, where each category contains two side-by-side bars. Based on the legend, the solid blue bars represent "Audio" and the solid purple bars represent "Noise". In the first, redacted category, the Audio bar reaches approximately 30%, while the Noise bar is the shortest on the chart at roughly 23%. For the "Audio-Reasoner" category, the Audio bar is near 37% and the Noise bar is about 31%. In the "Qwen-2.5-Omni" category, the Audio bar is the tallest overall at approximately 57%, and the Noise bar is around 36%. The bars are not sorted by height. Additionally, a light blue dashed horizontal line spans the width of the chart at approximately 29%, which the legend identifies as "Random Choice". The first category label on the horizontal axis is visually emphasized by being covered with a gray shaded box.
